items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: Me and Ryan Zorcas got to hang out with him a lot... me and Ryan joke about that too

ctx.x: Yeah. We tend to not want to think about those things. How about the best thing you’ve ever done? I mean is it possible to highlight a few?

Well you mean — just recently one of the greatest, yeah, we did the jam cruise which was last year, and I got to play with Maceo Parker, Fred Wesley and Pee Wee Ellis, on stage, right next to me. If you go, there’s pictures on Facebook and stuff, but what an honor that was, to be side by side with Pee Wee and like I said Maceo and Fred Wesley, was crazy. And we just got to do that again in New Orleans as well. Alfred Ellis, what a great guy he is, and he taught us a lot too. Me and Ryan Zorcas got to hang out…
You know it’s hard to put into words the way those guys play those horn parts. There’s something about it that’s just so cool.
